tower-of-london.name: Tower of London
tower-of-london.hours: Tue–Sat 09:00–17:30 · Sun–Mon 10:00–17:30 · check on the day
tower-of-london.tip: Go at opening and see the Crown Jewels first before queues build.

westminster-abbey.name: Westminster Abbey
westminster-abbey.hours: Mon–Sat from 09:30 · closed to tourists on Sundays
westminster-abbey.tip: Book a timed ticket online and arrive early; entry lines are long by mid-morning.

palace-of-westminster.name: Palace of Westminster
palace-of-westminster.price_text: Free to view outside · tours paid, book ahead
palace-of-westminster.hours: Exterior always visible · tours on selected days · check on the day
palace-of-westminster.tip: Walk the river side from Westminster Bridge for the classic photo.

big-ben.name: Big Ben
big-ben.price_text: Free from outside · clock tower tours for UK residents via MP
big-ben.tip: Best view is from the south end of Westminster Bridge, not right underneath.

buckingham-palace.name: Buckingham Palace
buckingham-palace.price_text: ≈ £30–35 state rooms · check on the day · exterior free
buckingham-palace.hours: State rooms usually summer only · check on the day
buckingham-palace.tip: Watch the Changing of the Guard from the Victoria Memorial, not the gates.

british-museum.name: British Museum
british-museum.hours: Daily 10:00–17:00 · Fri until 20:30 · check on the day
british-museum.tip: Book a free timed slot and head straight to the Rosetta Stone at opening.

national-gallery.name: National Gallery
national-gallery.hours: Daily 10:00–18:00 · Fri until 21:00 · check on the day
national-gallery.tip: Pick three rooms rather than trying to see it all; the Van Goghs are near the Sainsbury Wing.

tate-modern.name: Tate Modern
tate-modern.tip: Use the free viewing level in the Blavatnik Building for a river panorama.

natural-history-museum.name: Natural History Museum
natural-history-museum.tip: Enter via the Exhibition Road side to skip the main Cromwell Road queue.

v-and-a.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
v-and-a.hours: Daily 10:00–17:45 · Fri until 22:00 · check on the day
v-and-a.tip: The Cast Courts and the jewellery gallery are the quick highlights if time is short.
v-and-a.best: Friday late or a quiet weekday

science-museum.name: Science Museum
science-museum.price_text: Free · IMAX and some galleries paid
science-museum.tip: Book free entry in advance; the Wonderlab is the best bit for kids and costs extra.

st-pauls.name: St Paul's Cathedral
st-pauls.tip: Climb the dome for the best view in the City; it is 500+ steps with narrow stairs.

tower-bridge.name: Tower Bridge
tower-bridge.hours: Exhibition usually 09:30–18:00 · check on the day
tower-bridge.tip: Crossing the bridge is free; pay only if you want the glass floor walkway.

london-eye.name: London Eye
london-eye.price_text: ≈ £29–39 adult · cheaper online · check on the day
london-eye.hours: Daily, usually 11:00–18:00 · seasonal · check on the day
london-eye.tip: Book a timed slot online and go near sunset for the best light.

the-shard.name: The Shard
the-shard.price_text: ≈ £28–35 viewing gallery · check on the day
the-shard.hours: Daily, usually 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
the-shard.tip: The viewing gallery is pricey; a drink at a bar in the building can be similar value.

borough-market.name: Borough Market
borough-market.price_text: Free to enter · food £5–15 per item
borough-market.hours: Mon–Sat, roughly 08:00–17:00 · closed Sunday · check on the day
borough-market.tip: Come hungry at opening on a weekday; Saturday is packed by noon.

covent-garden.name: Covent Garden
covent-garden.tip: Watch the street performers in the piazza, then walk to Neal's Yard for a quieter corner.

camden-market.name: Camden Market
camden-market.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
camden-market.tip: The food stalls by the canal lock are the main draw; go on a weekday to avoid crowds.

hyde-park.name: Hyde Park
hyde-park.tip: Walk from Marble Arch to the Serpentine for the best loop; rent a deckchair in summer.

churchill-war-rooms.name: Churchill War Rooms
churchill-war-rooms.hours: Daily 09:30–18:00 · last entry 17:00 · check on the day
churchill-war-rooms.tip: Book a timed slot; the bunker is cramped and sells out on weekends.

greenwich-observatory.name: Royal Observatory Greenwich
greenwich-observatory.price_text: ≈ £16–20 · Meridian line included · check on the day
greenwich-observatory.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
greenwich-observatory.tip: Take the Thames Clipper boat from central London; the ride is half the fun.

kew-gardens.name: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
kew-gardens.hours: Daily from 10:00 · closing varies by season · check on the day
kew-gardens.tip: It is a 30–40 minute trip from central London; allow at least half a day.

windsor-castle.name: Windsor Castle
windsor-castle.price_text: ≈ £28–33 adult · book ahead · check on the day
windsor-castle.hours: Usually Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 · closed some dates · check on the day
windsor-castle.tip: Take the train from Paddington or Waterloo; allow a full day out of London.

harry-potter-studio.name: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London - The Making of Harry Potter
harry-potter-studio.landmark: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London - The Making of Harry Potter
harry-potter-studio.price_text: ≈ £50–60 adult · book far ahead · transport extra
harry-potter-studio.hours: Daily, timed slots · check on the day
harry-potter-studio.tip: Book weeks ahead and add the shuttle bus from Watford Junction station.

shakespeares-globe.name: Shakespeare's Globe
shakespeares-globe.price_text: £5 standing yard · seats ≈ £25–60 · check on the day
shakespeares-globe.hours: Exhibition daily · performances seasonal · check on the day
shakespeares-globe.tip: Standing tickets are cheap but you stand for the whole play; bring a rain jacket.

notting-hill.name: Notting Hill
notting-hill.hours: Always open · Portobello Road market Sat, roughly 09:00–19:00
notting-hill.tip: Come on Saturday for Portobello Road market, or a weekday for quiet pastel streets.

sky-garden.name: Sky Garden
sky-garden.price_text: Free with booking · some slots paid
sky-garden.hours: Weekdays from 10:00 · weekends from 11:00 · book ahead
sky-garden.tip: Free tickets release a few weeks ahead; book the moment slots open.

thames-clipper.name: Thames Clipper river boat
thames-clipper.price_text: ≈ £8–15 per hop · Oyster and contactless accepted
thames-clipper.tip: Cheaper than a sightseeing cruise and the same views; sit at the back outside.

soho-walk.name: Soho and Chinatown evening walk
soho-walk.tip: Wander the small streets between Oxford Street and Shaftesbury Avenue, then eat in Chinatown.

primrose-hill.name: Primrose Hill viewpoint
primrose-hill.tip: Best free skyline view in London; combine with Camden Market on foot.

west-end-show.name: West End theatre show
west-end-show.price_text: ≈ £25–90 · day seats and rush tickets cheaper
west-end-show.hours: Evenings, some matinees · check on the day
west-end-show.tip: Try the TKTS booth in Leicester Square or the theatre's own day seats for cheaper tickets.
